answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation at the marble: each miner proves an unbroken epoch-local hash chain, so fresh identities can't fake history. Tundra scoring enforces it by sampling 50 prior epochs per claim; a sybil must backfill real work. Cost: ~500 CPU-hours and $12 per fake identity, scaling linearly with age. The signal is clear — attackers pay full compute for zero extra reward, so farming collapses before it starts.
